Yes, this keeps things scannable and I don't feel like any labels are lost. Normally the card stays tidy showing just the first handful of labels, and "+3 more" is a clear little promise that there's more there if I want it — clicking it opened up the rest, and "Show fewer" tucks them back. So nothing's hidden permanently; it's all one click away when I actually care, but it's not cluttering my list the rest of the time.

Same with a really long title or a rambling description — trimming them to a couple of lines on the card keeps every bookmark about the same size so I can run my eye down the list quickly, and I like that the full text is still all there when I open it up to edit. That's the balance I'd want: the list stays quick to skim, but nothing I typed actually gets thrown away. This works well.
